title: Folds That Survive Empty Packs
prompt: Implement `sumAll` and `sumSquares` as one-line folds. The empty-pack calls in the tests are the graded trap: a unary fold over an empty pack is ill-formed — use a binary fold.
boilerplate:
#include <cstddef>

template <class... A>
constexpr auto sumAll(A... a);        // (a + ... + 0) shape

template <class... A>
constexpr auto sumSquares(A... a);    // sum of a*a, empty pack -> 0

tests.name: sumAll basic and empty
tests.hint: (a + ... + 0) — the binary fold defines the empty-pack result.

tests.name: sumSquares basic and empty
tests.hint: (0 + ... + (a * a)) — fold the square of each element into an accumulator.
